description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Twin Element Mode III (Ice, Holy)], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Rebel Rune Knight Mode] and Frozen Holy Sword +1 to the user

description.name: Chilling Crusade
description.text: Six single attacks (0.90 each), grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Solemn Campaign
description.text: One single attack (6.00) capped at 99999, cast time 0.825 if the user has any Magical Blink, grants [Magical Blink 1] to all allies if the user has Frozen Holy Sword level 1, causes Frozen Holy Sword -1 to the user

description.name: Twin Element Mode III (Ice, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Holy 2 with Stacking] after using a Ice/Holy ability

description.name: Rebel Rune Knight Mode
description.text: Keeps track of the number of Ice or Holy abilities used (0~4), grants [Rebel Rune Knight Critical] to the user after using a Ice or Holy ability, grants [Ice, Holy Ability +50% Boost 1] to the user after using two Ice or Holy abilities, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
